summary: Chenodiol has an official boxed warning in the United States regarding liver harm [3]. Because of the risk of liver damage, instructions call for testing liver health markers, including transaminase and bilirubin levels, at the start and checking them yearly or as needed, with treatment interrupted or stopped if abnormalities persist [5]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Chenodiol low risk scores for both the liver and the heart [M].
